europe_now.title: French Security Measures and Unrest
europe_now.summary: The French government has implemented targeted curfews and promised a massive police deployment ahead of upcoming demonstrations following recent civil unrest and rioting. Authorities are leveraging social media to identify looters, while political leaders work to secure critical fuel supplies from the Gulf states.

europe_now.title: Ukraine Defense Diplomacy in Oslo
europe_now.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy traveled to Oslo for high-level talks with United States envoys amid ongoing discussions regarding defense coordination and military supplies. American officials have denied withholding intelligence or assistance, even as Ukrainian leadership emphasizes the urgent need for support on the battlefield.
